status: Source analysis in progress. No Adult Leech runtime implementation or acceptance is claimed.

evidence.wiki_attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors; CC BY-SA 4.0. Preserved article is supplementary to the installed baseline.

identity.name: Adult Leech
identity.habitat: 22 positive-weight Corpse room templates; proposed DeathWard band 3. Template count is not a spawn probability.

ordinary_state_graph.0: Initialize state 3, recovery counter 0, one-time burrow counter -1; consume this update.
ordinary_state_graph.3: Recovery or wandering; acquire horizontal charge or the one-time low-health burrow.
ordinary_state_graph.8: Horizontal charge with limited vertical steering; wall collision returns to state 3.
ordinary_state_graph.6: Burrow animation followed by hidden waiting, then teleport to current target and enter state 7.
ordinary_state_graph.7: ChargeDown falling animation; Hit restores collision, emits ring; completion returns to state 3.

movement.ordinary_velocity_step: 0.8 * velocity + 0.7 * heading, after native AddVelocity/friction ordering; source decisions at 30 Hz.
movement.heading: Uniform angle from -45 to +45 degrees around positive X; a separate half-chance reverses X. Another half-chance reverses Y when pointing away from target Y. This is not the axis wander used by type 55.
movement.heading_updates: Choose when zero. On empty grid, a 1/30 draw rerolls; grid collision reverses both heading components. On nonempty grid, a 1/30 branch calls a separate free-position helper whose exact selection remains open.
movement.recovery: Positive recovery counter decreases by elapsed source frames; velocity retention is 0.9 and ordinary acquisition is skipped.
movement.charge_acquisition: 1/3 draw, absolute target Y separation < 30 source units. Ordinary branch has no line-of-sight or maximum-distance guard. Committed X sign points toward the current target; gain begins at 0.5.
movement.charge_velocity_step: Retention 0.86; X force is gain times committed sign. If target Y is more than 10 units above/below, Y force is gain times +/-0.12, clamped to [-2,2]. X sign remains committed.
movement.charge_gain: Increase by 0.2 per elapsed source frame, capped at 5, while gain < 1 or absolute X distance to target < 500.
movement.ordinary_charge_stop: Any grid collision stops charge. The ordinary state-8 path does not contain the low-speed timeout seen in separate state 9.
movement.wall_ring_guard: Length of native collision vector at +18c/+190 > 10 and its normalized dot with +194/+198 > 0.6. The exact engine meaning of these collision fields still needs confirmation.
movement.strong_impact: Screen shake 6, sound 72, velocity recoil of 2.5 times collision vector +194/+198, recovery 12 source frames, BounceOverlay, and 12-shot ring. Weak collision still stops charge without this ring.

burrow_and_fall.trigger: Only while counter is negative, HP/maxHP < 0.66, current grid is empty, and (absolute Y separation > absolute X separation OR absolute Y separation > 80), with a 1/3 draw.
burrow_and_fall.burrow_entry: Set counter to 0 and targetPosition to current grid center. Source grid spacing is 40; origin is (40,120).
burrow_and_fall.burrow_events: Burrow Sound frame 8 emits sound 72. Hit frame 22 emits sound 66 and sets EntityCollisionClass to 0.
burrow_and_fall.hidden_wait: After the 25-frame Burrow finishes, clear anchor and velocity and increment counter. Once counter > 30, a 1/15 draw enters state 7, teleports to the current target, sets GridCollisionClass to 5 and plays sound 510 before falling.
burrow_and_fall.pre_hit_fall: ChargeDown before Hit follows the current target through helper 7a3650 with speed argument 0.8 and arguments 0,true. It is not stationary after the initial teleport.
burrow_and_fall.pathfinder_correction: The helper's velocity reset at 7a37fc is gated by status flags (0x200 present and 0x100 absent), not its normal pursuit path. Do not interpret that branch as ordinary constant-speed movement.
burrow_and_fall.ordinary_pathfinder_output: For a selected destination more than one source unit away, the common path multiplies friction by 0.7 and adds normalized force equal to min(distance*0.1,2) * argument 0.8 * terrain factor. Terrain factor is initialized to 1 and can become 0.7. Distance <= 1 applies friction 0.5; absent destination applies 0.85. Exact native grid selection and status paths are not yet ported.
burrow_and_fall.landing_hit: ChargeDown Hit frame 18: GridCollisionClass 3, screen shake 12, sound 77, zero velocity, set anchor to current position, EntityCollisionClass 4 and emit 10-shot ring.
burrow_and_fall.landing_settle: While anchor exists, velocity is 0.7 * velocity + (anchor - position). Sound frame 31 emits sound 72 and clears anchor; subsequent movement retains velocity by 0.8. Animation completion at 43 frames returns to state 3.
burrow_and_fall.one_time: The burrow counter is never restored to -1 in the ordinary loop, so this attack happens at most once per actor.
burrow_and_fall.vulnerability_caution: EntityCollisionClass 0 establishes absent body collision, not by itself immunity to every damage route. Bomb, area, execution and scripted damage handling must be traced before applying a blanket damage rejection.

projectiles.shared: Default ProjectileParams: scale 1, height -23 and random falling speed [-0.1,0.1). Mode 9 increments the ring angle before emission. These branches do not set wall-bounce flags.
projectiles.proposed_existing_engine_conversion: Planar speed 30/24, height 1.15, upward speed [-0.15,0.15], gravity 8.1/3.6, retention 0.9, radius 0.22, damage 10 before shared enemy multiplier. Conversion is a DeathWard adaptation, not a source value.

other_source_paths.state_5: External travelling charge can leave room bounds and remove actor; ordinary entry route not identified.
other_source_paths.state_9: Separate fixed-direction charge uses force 3.8 and retention 0.86; has a low-speed counter and stronger impact branch calling FireBossProjectiles. Entry route remains untraced.
other_source_paths.state_10: ChargeHit recovery after state 9; Sound at frame 11 kicks back with force 5 and clears anchor. Returns to state 3 on completion.
other_source_paths.death: Controller tail emits three gore effects; no offspring found in this controller. Shared mortality and all external spawning routes remain to be checked.

implementation_requirements: Dedicated controller, external profile, 30-Hz decisions with continuous collision integration, separate ordinary and falling collision rules.
Do not reuse type-55 leech behavior: its acquisition, steering and phases differ.
Preserve whole projectile packets under capacity pressure and document that safety adaptation.
Source HP 90 would become 288 at existing conversion; contact 2 becomes 20 before shared multiplier. Preserve player defaults.
Knockback immunity is stated by the revision-pinned wiki; verify corresponding installed flags and shared knockback path.
Seeded band-3 reachability, native behavior tests, browser behavior traces and original-style captures are required before counting runtime progress.
remaining_research: Confirm the collision-vector fields and strong-impact sign against engine collision processing.
Trace general damage handling while EntityCollisionClass is zero, including bombs and area damage.
Resolve state-5/state-9 creation routes and special encounter dependencies.
Trace statuses, control/charm, champions and freeze interactions; do not infer fidelity from the ordinary hostile loop.
Exact grid helper decisions, RNG order, frame ordering and shared mortality remain unverified.
No runtime, reachability, visual, balance or performance acceptance evidence exists for Adult Leech yet.
